name: @fromcode119/extension-builder
description: Builds plugins, themes and appearances. Node-only build tooling, never imported by application code — and never by a plugin, which reaches it through context.extensions.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --packages=external --outfile=dist/index.cjs && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external --outfile=dist/index.js
